item.title: Hittsumi: Iwate's Hand-Torn Dumpling Soup — Guide
item.description: Hittsumi is a beloved Iwate country soup — flat pieces of wheat dough are torn by hand and simmered with root vegetables, mushrooms and chicken or fish in a soy or miso broth. Hearty, humble and deeply warming, it’s classic rural home cooking, at its best in winter and served at local restaurants and inns across the prefecture. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Rural Iwate & Morioka Hours Restaurant hours Admission ~¥600–900 a bowl Time needed About 40 min Best time Winter (warming dish) What to Try Hand-torn wheat-dough dumplings in savory broth.
